name: SmartLinker AI
description: Adds an AI CKEditor feature that lets editors auto-generate contextual links.
project_description:
SmartLinker AI is a Drupal module that automates internal linking to improve SEO, user experience, and editor efficiency. It is built for marketing teams, content marketers, SEO specialists, and content editors who use Drupal.

 Features 
 SmartLinker makes internal linking effortless:

 
 Automates internal linking, cutting down manual effort. 
 Ensures consistency across your entire site. 
 Boosts SEO rankings with efficient, strategic linking. 
 Enhances user navigation, driving higher engagement. 
 
 How SmartLinker AI Works 
 

 This video has been fast-forwarded for brevity. The AI processing took longer in real-time. 

 
 Add Content – Paste or write content in CKEditor. 
 Select Text – Highlight the text where you want internal links. (You can select the full content but we recommend not selecting more than 1500 words at a time as this might impact the quality of the internal links that AI chooses for your keywords 
 Click on the "AI Assistant" dropdown in your CKEditor and select " Generate internal links " 
 A window appears with: 
 
 Target content types 
 Focus keywords for SEO 
 A preview of selected text 
 A placeholder for the text that's enhanced with internal links 
 Buttons to Generate Links and Save to the editor 
 
 When you click on the " Generate Links " button, the AI scans your content and indexed pages and adds internal links seamlessly into your content. 
 Review & Save – Make edits if needed, then click " Save changes to editor " 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 AI Core 

 AI CKEditor 

 OpenAI Provider 

 AI Search 

 Milvus Vector Database Provider 

 Zilliz Cloud 

 Quick Installation Steps 
 1. Set Up Zilliz Cloud

 
 Sign up on Zilliz Cloud and create a cluster (free: 1 cluster, 5GB storage). 
 Copy the endpoint and API key from the cluster settings. 
 
 2. Set Up Milvus DB

 
 Install and enable the Milvus module. 
 Copy the API token from Zilliz Cloud. 
 Save it as a .key file and place it in the correct directory. 
 
 3. Configure AI Search Server

 
 In Search API settings, select AI Search as the backend. 
 Choose Milvus DB and link it to your Zilliz collection. 
 Create a search index, select Content as the data source, and configure indexing settings. 
 
 4. Define Fields for Indexing

 
 Content Type: Filterable attributes. 
 Title: Main content. 
 Body: Contextual content. 
 Index additional fields as needed. 
 
 5. Set Up CKEditor

 
 Navigate to /admin/config/content/formats. 
 Enable SmartLinker AI Module in CKEditor 5. 
 Select the search index and OpenAI GPT-4o as the AI provider. 
 Save the settings. 
 
 Community Documentation 
 A detailed installation guide 

 We built SmartLinker AI to solve our own content struggles. Now it’s here for you! Say goodbye to manual linking and let AI do the work. Install it today and focus on creating great content!
